mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO tb_product_favorite(user_id, product_id, state) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT f.product_id FROM tb_product_favorite f JOIN tb_product p ON p.id = f.product_id AND p.status = 1 JOIN tb_shop s ON s.id = p.shop_id AND s.business_status = 1 WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.state = 1 ORDER BY f.update_time DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
